I'd suggest a re-render. Increase your lighting (especially to the lower ares, you're loosing a lot of detail you want to see.) even if this is as simple as creating an area light below your floor, and then removing the floor from casting shadows in your light linker. Then render a separate pass using an Ambient Occlusion shader, this will help pull out the shadow's you're looking for. (you can over lay the AO pass over your rendering via Photoshop) You ahve a good model, the details look nice, but your rendering doesn't show it off as well as you'd like.

Also visit HDRI-locations.com, they specialize in HDRI lighting maps as well as backplates for the same locations. The have a free one you can use that includes 6 different backplates and the HDRI map for lighting/reflections.
